file src/argraph.cc has been modified by removing keyword register in line 253 and 283.
in both cases
register int a, b, c;
was changed to:
int a, b, c;

file src/argloader.cc is not used in the project
i.e. removed from project without deleting files
(files include/argloader.h and src/argloader.cc 
are not part of the CMake target 'vflib')
This is due to the deprecation of <strstream>
included in argloader.h
